controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Galileo’s highest-resolution pair, 107318313 and 107318326, mapped onto the Thomas shape. The source is high-pass filtered and retains photographed illumination; it is not calibrated albedo or natural color. Best original detail is approximately 55 m/pixel and varies greatly. The gray grid marks poor or missing coverage. Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting.

controls.summary: Galileo images mapped onto the shape. Shadows and seams remain; the gray grid marks poor or missing data.

controls.label: Calibrated image
controls.description: Galileo’s 1991 clear-filter image, calibrated to reflectance (I/F) and placed using the published shape and camera controls. Brightness retains the photographed illumination; it is not surface albedo. A fixed 0–0.12 I/F display range uses gamma 2.2. Bad detector pixels, uncertain edges and unobserved areas use the gray grid.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows the published shape radius minus a 6.1 km reference sphere, including Gaspra’s broad irregular shape. This is shape-derived height, not gravitational elevation or a photographic observation. Shape constraints vary with the flyby coverage; unseen regions are less certain. Brightness adds cartographic relief; Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting.
